plainText:
Tomohiro Waki (Japanese: 脇知弘 Waki Tomohiro) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Waki was born on October 11, 1980, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He provided the voice of Stephan, one of 's rivals in the Unova region, during . Waki is currently affiliated with the talent agency AT Production. In addition, he is a professional wrestler.
